content: is that really a reasonable assumption? you have 32–63 slots to include the slashing and if there is no block in that time you would also not reach the quorum, so it's likely there is a proposer that included the slashing, of course it is not guaranteed but if you assume slashings are not reliable doesn't that also break FFG security assumptions?
